summary: Verified the requested Temp Ref ID lazy-generation bug fix on /vendor. The fix described in files_of_reference has NOT been implemented in the current codebase. On a fresh /vendor load (after clearing localStorage and logging in as admin/admin@123), field-tempRefId still shows an auto-generated 'TMP-1147EFB3' value instead of the required placeholder 'Generated on First Save'. Reading /app/frontend/src/lib/store.js confirms createVendorDraft() still generates tempRefId eagerly (lines 72-77), there is no exported generateTempRefId() helper, and /app/frontend/src/pages/VendorRegistration.jsx has no import/usage of generateTempRefId, no empty-check in handleSave, no empty-guard in handleSubmit, and no fallback rendering for empty tempRefId. Since the primary code change is missing, all downstream checklist items (save toast format, submit-without-save guard, resave keeps same id, new-draft resets to placeholder) cannot pass and were not further tested to avoid noise. Main agent must apply the described changes before retest.

ui_bugs.issue: tempRefId is eagerly generated on draft creation (TMP-XXXXXXXX shown on fresh load) instead of being empty. Expected: createVendorDraft() sets tempRefId:'' and a separate exported generateTempRefId() helper is used on first Save only.
handleSave does not lazily generate tempRefId when empty (feature not implemented).
handleSubmit does not refuse to advance when tempRefId is empty (guard not implemented).
Input has no fallback display of 'Generated on First Save' for empty state — currently binds directly to vendor.tempRefId.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/lib/store.js: change createVendorDraft() to set tempRefId:'' and export a new generateTempRefId() helper returning `TMP-${8 uppercase hex chars}`.

In /app/frontend/src/pages/VendorRegistration.jsx: import generateTempRefId; in handleSave, if !vendor.tempRefId, assign generateTempRefId() before upsert; in handleSubmit, block with toast 'Save the record first (Temp Ref ID required)' when tempRefId is empty; render `value={vendor.tempRefId || 'Generated on First Save'}` for field-tempRefId (or similar fallback).
Ensure handleNew() (already spreads createVendorDraft) results in blank tempRefId again after approval → new draft.
After applying, retest full workflow (Save → same id on re-save → Submit → Approve produces AE####JV#### and preserves TMP- id) plus regression: /final single .a4, /bill Section 2B btn-add-item-row.
critical_code_review_comments: The review request's files_of_reference claims changes that are not present in the actual files — indicates the main agent's edit did not persist or was not made. Verify diff before handing off to testing.

field-tempRefId is a plain <input> bound to vendor.tempRefId with no placeholder or empty-state handling; use `value={vendor.tempRefId || 'Generated on First Save'}` (readOnly) so React controlled-input warnings are avoided.
test_credentials: admin / admin@123 (from default seed in store.js)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once main agent applies the two-file change (store.js createVendorDraft empty tempRefId + export generateTempRefId; VendorRegistration.jsx lazy generation in handleSave, guard in handleSubmit, fallback text in field-tempRefId), rerun the 8-step checklist in the request. Login flow: /login → username 'admin' pw 'admin@123' → navigate to /vendor. Field is readonly — read via get_attribute('value'). Regex for post-save: /^TMP-[0-9A-F]{8}$/.
rca of the issue: Root cause: createVendorDraft() in /app/frontend/src/lib/store.js still eagerly generates TMP-XXXXXXXX in its initializer IIFE (lines 72-77). VendorRegistration.jsx never re-generates or clears it. The main agent's stated code changes were not actually applied to the repo. Reproduction: 1) clear localStorage 2) login admin/admin@123 3) go /vendor 4) read field-tempRefId value — observed 'TMP-1147EFB3', expected 'Generated on First Save'. Mitigation: apply the changes listed in action_items.
